summary_1line: King Dasaratha asks sage Rishyasringa to officiate the horse sacrifice for an heir, and the sage agrees while priests and sages are summoned.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha bows respectfully before the ascetic Rishyasringa in the palace court, requesting his help in performing the sacred horse sacrifice.
Messengers hurry across the kingdom as Minister Sumantra summons revered sages like Vasishtha and Vamadeva to the royal court.
Rishyasringa solemnly instructs that the ritual horse be released while priests gather materials for the grand sacrifice.
